data.title: 塔露拉 · 废墟尖塔残照下的飞雪与火烬
data.description: 夕阳残照洒满切尔诺伯格破损的旧钟塔天台。塔露拉身着高领厚毛衣与长靴迎风伫立在断壁旁，指尖燃着一簇温和微弱的小火苗。她眺望着远方无垠的感染者土地，冷峻的神色中流露出一丝对和平的深切追寻与落寞。
data.location: 被战争摧毁的旧钟塔残破尖顶
data.action: 指尖托着微弱火苗眺望远方，微风吹拂长发
data.lighting: 冬日血色残阳与指尖微弱火苗的幽光
data.promptProse: Standing on the crumbling rooftop parapet against a bruised winter sunset, a gentle ember hovers above her bare fingertip. Her cream knit sweater shields her from the biting wind as she gazes into the horizon with quiet, solemn resolve.
data.animaCaption: She stands at the ruined tower edge watching the crimson sunset with an ember at her fingertip.
